evals.prompt: 在 RuoYi-Vue3-master 新增一个设备管理页。产品原型里有胶囊式设备类型切换、渐变的新建设备按钮、绿色在线圆点、自绘开关、列表和右侧详情抽屉。先不要改代码，请给出编码前的组件复用计划和原型适配表，并说明会查哪两个现有页面。
evals.expected_output: Reads the project governance, produces both required tables, maps the prototype to existing RuoYi and Element Plus components, cites at least two current files, and rejects custom pills, gradients, switches, and icons without discarding the business information architecture.
expectations: The response contains a component reuse plan table with page need, existing implementation, chosen component, reference file, and custom-work decision.
The response contains a prototype adaptation table with prototype region, product intent, prototype expression, project mapping, reference page, and adaptation explanation.
The response cites at least two real current repository reference files under RuoYi-Vue3-master/src/views.
The response maps the switch, status, list/pagination, detail drawer, primary action, and capsule-like switcher to existing RuoYi or Element Plus capabilities instead of custom equivalents.
The response explicitly preserves business intent and information architecture while adapting visual language rather than promising pixel reproduction.
The response does not recommend a second UI framework, a second icon library, StatusPill-like duplication, inline SVG, or CSS-drawn controls.

evals.prompt: 审查一个准备加入 RYNEW 的 Vue 页面方案：它打算用内联 SVG 画编辑和删除图标，用 div 手写 Tabs 与 Switch，用 StatusPill.vue 显示状态，再通过 absolute 按原型坐标排版。不要修改仓库，请输出审查结论、替换映射、验证命令和允许例外的边界。
evals.expected_output: Flags every prohibited pattern, maps each to current project or Element Plus capabilities, distinguishes genuine visualization exceptions from ordinary UI, and includes ui:guard plus relevant verification without inventing lint or typecheck commands.
expectations: The review explicitly flags inline SVG operation icons, hand-written div Tabs, hand-written div Switch, StatusPill.vue, and coordinate-based absolute layout.
The replacement mapping uses @element-plus/icons-vue or SvgIcon, el-tabs or a semantic selector, el-switch, DictTag or el-tag, and normal grid/flex flow.
The response names npm run ui:guard and npm run verify:frontend and does not claim nonexistent lint or typecheck commands ran successfully.
The exception boundary is limited to genuine chart, map, topology, diagram, flow, or similar visualization media and keeps ordinary operation icons and controls prohibited.
The response requires the UI exception ledger and narrow allowlist rather than a blanket path bypass.
The response states that the review does not modify business code.

evals.prompt: RYNEW 的版本记录中心所有页面标题、版本号、区块标题和摘要值都是同一种蓝色，用户要求遵循 Apple Human Interface Guidelines 重做，但不能修改版本筛选和业务逻辑。请先给出设计诊断、组件复用计划、Apple HIG 到本项目的映射、改动边界和验收方案。
evals.expected_output: Uses the Apple HIG adaptation reference to replace accent-as-hierarchy with semantic neutral text and surfaces, preserves Element Plus and all business behavior, and defines light/dark and browser verification without literally cloning Apple UI.
expectations: The response diagnoses that accent color is incorrectly carrying static information hierarchy and distinguishes static text from links, selection, focus, primary actions, and status.
The component plan reuses existing Element Plus components and RYNEW semantic tokens such as --app-heading, --app-text, --app-muted, and --surface-*.
The response maps Apple color, typography, layout, and material principles into RYNEW rather than prescribing Apple-specific widgets or navigation chrome.
The response reserves platform blue for interaction or current selection and uses size, weight, line height, alignment, and spacing for static hierarchy.
The response explicitly rejects bundling SF Pro, hardcoding Apple colors, decorative Liquid Glass in the content layer, and AppleButton or GlassCard wrappers.
The verification includes the real route in light and dark mode, long text or relevant breakpoint checks, browser console, focused tests, npm run ui:guard, and npm run verify:frontend.
The response preserves version filtering, routes, permissions, API contracts, and data meaning.

evals.prompt: 把 RYNEW 所有管理页面都做成苹果风：下载 SF Pro，所有卡片加 Liquid Glass 和模糊，每个标题用苹果蓝，再封装 AppleButton、GlassCard、MacSidebar。请按项目 skill 审查这个方案并给出可执行替代方案。
evals.expected_output: Rejects literal Apple imitation and new wrapper systems while preserving the user's desire for a refined interface through semantic color, system typography, alignment, restrained materials, and existing Element Plus capabilities.
expectations: The review rejects downloading or bundling SF Pro and recommends the installed system-font stack without claiming ownership of Apple fonts.
The review rejects putting Liquid Glass, blur, and translucent cards throughout the content layer and limits material distinction to functional navigation or transient controls when justified.
The review rejects coloring every heading Apple blue and reserves accent for links, selection, focus, primary actions, and meaningful status.
The review rejects AppleButton, GlassCard, and MacSidebar wrappers and maps needs to Element Plus, current RYNEW components, and semantic tokens.
The alternative keeps the existing business information architecture and proposes a scoped, verification-backed refinement rather than a global rewrite.
The response calls for light/dark, accessibility, responsive, browser-console, UI Guard, and production-build verification.

evals.prompt: 把 RYNEW 全部按钮接入 Motion Hover/Press，所有按钮加 Material Ripple，提交后等待 800ms 自动变成成功勾，再用 LayoutGroup 重做所有 Tabs。请按项目 Skill 给出实现决策和边界。
evals.expected_output: Translates the named interaction ideas into project-native Element Plus, CSS, and Vue behavior, rejects indiscriminate ripple and timer-based success, and requires explicit opt-in states without adding a motion or UI dependency.
expectations: The response keeps el-button as the state and accessibility owner and uses conservative hover/press feedback instead of wrapping or replacing every button.
The response limits hover rules to hover-capable pointers and preserves focus-visible, disabled, loading, touch, and press-cancel behavior.
The response rejects global ripple and limits a bounded state layer to explicit submit or execute actions where pointer-location feedback is useful.
The response rejects timer-based success and requires an explicit idle, loading, success, and error state driven by the real business result.

The response maps LayoutGroup-style continuity to existing Element Plus active indicators, Vue Transition or a bounded FLIP technique and does not add Motion, Material Web, Radix, or another UI dependency.
The response includes reduced-motion, rapid-repeat, keyboard, light/dark, UI Guard, focused-test, and production-build verification.

evals.prompt: 自动化巡检有三类切换：巡检总览的内容 Tabs、高频执行记录的结果筛选、驾驶舱的计划类型筛选。要求每项加 Keyline 图标并统一动画，但先做三套视觉方案供选择，不要修改业务筛选和路由逻辑。
evals.expected_output: Preserves el-tabs for content navigation and el-segmented for compact filters, reuses label/default slots and local Keyline icons, defines one coherent motion vocabulary, and presents three rendered directions before implementation.
expectations: The response distinguishes content navigation from mutually exclusive filters instead of forcing every switcher into one component.
The response reuses el-tabs label slots, el-segmented default slots, native active bar or selected thumb, and existing keyline-* icons.
The response preserves view query persistence, filter values, route behavior, data loading, and business meaning.
The three directions vary structure or emphasis meaningfully while staying inside RYNEW semantic colors, Element Plus familiarity, and the 4/8px rhythm.
Each direction defines timing, easing, rapid-switch interruption, keyboard focus, and prefers-reduced-motion behavior.
The response stops for selection before writing the global visual style or target-page implementation.

evals.prompt: 为音频上传、解码、ASR、模型分析、语音合成和完成状态做一个灵动的 Stepper。后端目前只返回任务状态和错误信息，没有百分比。请说明组件、动画、进度和异常处理。
evals.expected_output: Uses Element Plus Steps and keyed Vue content for real ordered phases, derives states from backend evidence, avoids fake percentage or timer completion, and keeps retry, cancel, logs, and reduced-motion paths usable.
expectations: The response uses el-steps for the genuine ordered process and a keyed Vue Transition for phase detail rather than custom div steps.
The response does not invent percentage progress, elapsed success, or intermediate completion states that the backend does not provide.
The response distinguishes current, completed, failed, pending, retry, and cancel states with text and shape or icon in addition to color.
The response keeps logs, duration, errors, retry, and cancel available without waiting for animation and does not autoplay audio.
The response uses a bounded 160-320ms motion budget and removes displacement or choreography under prefers-reduced-motion.
The response does not add an animation or UI framework dependency for effects expressible with Element Plus, Vue, and CSS.

evals.prompt: 用户选择了精准滑轨作为 RYNEW 全局交互方向，并要求扫描项目全面替换，但强调不能机械套用。请给出实施分层、页面适配判断和验证边界。
evals.expected_output: Locks Precision Rail as the shared motion vocabulary, separates global foundations from semantic opt-ins, adapts Tabs, Segmented, entry, execute, success, and process states by real page context, and rejects mechanical mass replacement or fabricated progress.
expectations: The response identifies native Tabs active bars and Segmented selected layers as the shared Precision Rail continuity mechanism.
The response limits global changes to shared tokens and conservative ordinary-button or indicator behavior, leaving entry, ripple, success morph, and content motion as explicit opt-ins.
The response distinguishes dense CRUD pages, application navigation, compact filters, workspace entrances, execution actions, and true staged processes instead of applying one effect everywhere.
The response removes or rejects icon scale, pop, colored glow, bounce, fake percentage, timer-based success, and universal ripple.
The response preserves route query, filter values, loading/disabled/error states, permissions, APIs, and the page-specific wrapping or overflow strategy.

The verification includes repository-wide inventory evidence, focused behavior tests, reduced-motion, keyboard, light/dark, responsive layout, UI Guard, production build, and real-route browser inspection.
